{{Top|leg}}
The '''Regent of Alderaan''' was a position in the court of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] comedian [[Rewello]] once performed for an individual holding that office sometime during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="HSCSSB">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A "Regent of Alderaan" was mentioned in the [[1993]] roleplaying guide ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="HSCSSB" /> In the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 67|67th issue]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', it was also stated that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] transferred his functions to a [[Bail Prestor Organa's regent|regent]] in order to become [[Senator/Legends|senator]].<ref name="FF67">{{FactFile|67|ORG 1-2|Bail Organa}}</ref>
